title: Are you sure? A Comprehensive and Comprehensible Survey of Uncertainty Quantification in Symbolic Regression
authors: Julia Reuter; Fabricio Olivetti de Franca
relation: 当前最系统的 SR-UQ 综述，明确把模型结构不确定性列入 UQ，并系统整理 Bayesian SR、模型选择与结构 UQ 文献。

title: Bayesian Symbolic Regression with Entropic Reinforcement Learning
authors: Oussama Boussif et al.
relation: ERRLESS 直接学习表达式后验分布，用最大熵 RL 对 expression structure sampling，与你想把 LLM-SR 从单解升级为结构 posterior 高度重合。

title: Bayesian Symbolic Regression via Posterior Sampling
authors: Geoffrey F. Bomarito; Patrick E. Leser
relation: 用 SMC 近似 symbolic expression 的 posterior，明确维护多模态结构后验，而非只保留一个最佳公式。

title: Probabilistic Symbolic Regression for Equation Discovery via Operator-Induced and Regularized Symbolic Forests
authors: Somjit Roy; Pritam Dey; Bani K. Mallick; Debdeep Pati
scope: 自由形式结构 posterior / non-identifiability
relation: 最接近你的结构 identifiability 问题。论文明确指出 symbolic representations non-identifiable，并用 Occam's window posterior summary 保留多个 plausible symbolic structures。

title: VaSST: Variational Inference for Symbolic Regression using Soft Symbolic Trees
authors: Somjit Roy; Pritam Dey; Bani K. Mallick
relation: 把离散符号树连续松弛为 soft symbolic trees，用变分推断得到 symbolic structures 的 posterior，属于另一条结构 UQ 技术路线。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Symbolic Regression through Bayesian Support Selection
authors: Satadeep Bhattacharjee
relation: 输出 competing descriptor supports 的 posterior probability，直接展示确定性 SR 会掩盖的多个竞争结构。限制是基于 SISSO support space。

title: Bayesian Symbolic Regression
authors: Ying Jin; Weilin Fu; Jian Kang; Jiadong Guo; Jian Guo
relation: 早期自由形式 Bayesian SR，通过 MCMC 从 symbolic-tree posterior 采样，是后续结构 posterior 方法的重要基础。

title: A Bayesian machine scientist to aid in the solution of challenging scientific problems
authors: Roger Guimera et al.
relation: 对闭式模型建立 marginal posterior，MCMC 搜索模型空间，并学习表达式结构 prior，是 Bayesian machine scientist 主线的奠基工作。

title: Bayesian symbolic regression: automated equation discovery from a physicist's perspective
authors: Roger Guimera; Marta Sales-Pardo
scope: 理论视角 / 模型集合
relation: 从统计物理与 Bayesian 角度解释为什么 SR 应考虑 model ensembles 而非单一最优模型，适合建立问题定义。

title: Priors for Symbolic Regression
authors: Deaglan J. Bartlett; Harry Desmond; Pedro G. Ferreira
relation: 研究结构 prior 与 Bayesian evidence，在多个竞争 symbolic models 间进行有原则的模型比较。

title: Automated Learning of Interpretable Models with Quantified Uncertainty
authors: G. F. Bomarito et al.
relation: Bayesian GPSR，用 marginal likelihood 参与 GP 选择，联合模型证据和参数 UQ，是 Bomarito posterior-sampling 路线的前身。

title: Bayesian Model Selection for Reducing Bloat and Overfitting in Genetic Programming for Symbolic Regression
authors: Geoffrey F. Bomarito et al.
relation: 早期用 Bayesian model evidence 取代纯误差 fitness，重点是 model selection、复杂度和噪声鲁棒性。

title: Comparing Methods for Estimating Marginal Likelihood in Symbolic Regression
authors: Patrick Leser; Geoffrey Bomarito; Gabriel Kronberger; Fabricio Olivetti de Franca
relation: 比较 SMC 与 Laplace 对 symbolic model marginal likelihood 的估计，直接影响多个候选结构的 Bayesian 排序。

title: Ensemble Bayesian Model Averaging in Genetic Programming
authors: Alexandros Agapitos; Michael O'Neill; Anthony Brabazon
relation: 明确指出选一个 GP 模型会忽略 model-selection uncertainty，采用 Bayesian Model Averaging 对种群中的竞争模型加权。

title: GFN-SR: Symbolic Regression with Generative Flow Networks
authors: Sida Li; Ioana Marinescu; Sebastian Musslick
relation: 不是严格 Bayesian posterior，但目标是生成多样化高奖励表达式，适合作为结构分布生成器/候选集合基线。

title: EGG-SR: Embedding Symbolic Equivalence into Symbolic Regression via Equality Graph
authors: Nan Jiang; Ziyi Wang; Yexiang Xue
relation: 用 e-graph 合并数学等价但语法不同的表达式，并集成 MCTS、DRL、LLM。做结构 posterior 时非常关键，否则概率质量会被等价语法形式人为分裂。

title: Improving Genetic Programming for Symbolic Regression with Equality Graphs
authors: Fabricio Olivetti de Franca; Gabriel Kronberger
relation: 用 equality graph 检测已访问的等价表达式，减少搜索重复，为“结构等价类而非语法树”提供工程基础。

title: Active Learning in Genetic Programming: Guiding Efficient Data Collection for Symbolic Regression
authors: Nathan Haut; Wolfgang Banzhaf; Bill Punch
relation: 直接用 GP population ensemble 的 disagreement / differential entropy 选择最有信息量的新数据点，和“候选方程分不清就主动采数据”高度相关。

title: Active Learning Improves Performance on Symbolic Regression Tasks in StackGP
authors: Nathan Haut; Wolfgang Banzhaf; Bill Punch
relation: 较早的 SR 主动学习工作，通过模型集合预测不确定性选择新样本。

title: Ensemble-SINDy: Robust sparse model discovery in the low-data, high-noise limit, with active learning and control
authors: Urban Fasel et al.
venue: Proceedings of the Royal Society A 2022
relation: 用 ensemble 产生候选项 inclusion probability，并用 forecast variance 选择高不确定区域采样，展示结构 UQ 与 active learning 的完整闭环。

title: Optimal experiment design for practical parameter identifiability and model discrimination
authors: Y. Liu; P. K. Maini; R. E. Baker
relation: 模型区分部分直接设计输入，使 rival models 的预测差异最大，是把 SR 结构 posterior 推进到主动证伪的通用方法基础。

title: Optimal Experimental Design for Model Discrimination
authors: Jay I. Myung; Mark A. Pitt
relation: 经典 model discrimination OED：选择使竞争模型最可区分的实验设计，是“主动找证据区分公式”的理论祖先。

title: An anticipatory approach to optimal experimental design for model discrimination
authors: Brecht M. R. Donckels et al.
relation: 针对 rival dynamic models 主动设计最能区分模型的实验条件，并显式考虑预测与测量不确定性。

title: Equation discovery for nonlinear dynamical systems: A Bayesian viewpoint
authors: R. Fuentes et al.
relation: Bayesian sparse structure detection + parameter estimation，但结构只能从预定义 dictionary 中选项，适合作为结构 UQ 的受限版前身。

title: On spike-and-slab priors for Bayesian equation discovery of nonlinear dynamical systems via sparse linear regression
authors: Rajdip Nayek; Ramon Fuentes; Keith Worden; Elizabeth J. Cross
relation: 对 dictionary basis 是否进入方程做 Bayesian variable selection，后验样本同时用于结构选择与参数估计。

title: Sparsifying Priors for Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification in Model Discovery
authors: Seth M. Hirsh; David A. Barajas-Solano; J. Nathan Kutz
relation: UQ-SINDy 不只估参数，还给 candidate function inclusion probability，是固定字典里的结构不确定性量化。

title: Equation Discovery with Bayesian Spike-and-Slab Priors and Efficient Kernels
authors: Da Long et al.
relation: KBASS 用 Bayesian spike-and-slab 做 operator selection 与 UQ，适合对照自由形式 SR 的结构 posterior。

title: Rapid Bayesian identification of sparse nonlinear dynamics from scarce and noisy data
authors: David A. B. et al.
relation: 快速 Bayesian-SINDy，重点是稀疏动力学结构与不确定性，对主动学习和动态系统场景有参考价值。

title: Bayesian autoencoders for data-driven discovery of coordinates, governing equations and fundamental constants
authors: Gao; Kutz
relation: 联合 latent coordinate discovery 与 Bayesian equation discovery，提供模型结构及潜变量不确定性的扩展视角。

title: Comprehensive Framework for Model Discovery and Discrimination Based on Symbolic Regression and Structural Identifiability
authors: Xuming Yuan; Brahim Benyahia
scope: 参数/状态结构可辨识性
relation: 把 SR 与 structural identifiability/observability 接起来，但这里的 identifiability 主要指给定模型的参数与状态唯一性。用于界定术语，避免和“多个方程结构难区分”混淆。

title: PyCC.id: A package for hypothesis-driven equation discovery with structural identifiability
authors: Federico J. Gonzalez
relation: 用 hypothesis skeleton + structural identifiability 检查候选 ODE family。与结构选择有关，但概念仍偏传统结构可辨识性。

title: Incorporating Model Identifiability into Equation Discovery of ODE Systems
authors: Dirk De Pauw; Bernard De Baets
relation: 早期把 identifiability 指标放进 equation discovery fitness。重要历史文献，但核心仍是参数可辨识性而非自由形式结构 posterior。
